topic: User.payment_method_id la FK toi PaymentMethod da chon
statement: Theo tai lieu `qikfiliate/Domain Entities` Section: User (Affiliate), payment_method_id la FK toi PaymentMethod ma affiliate da chon de nhan thanh toan.

confirmation_source.ref: qikfiliate/Domain Entities (01-domain-entities.md) v1 Section: Domain Entities > User (Affiliate)

topic: payment_info la chuoi don gian, dung khi khong can bank details
statement: Theo tai lieu `qikfiliate/Domain Entities` Section: User (Affiliate) (corroborate boi `dashboard - payment and payout request` Section: Buoc 1), User.payment_info la chuoi thong tin thanh toan don gian, dung khi payment method da chon KHONG can bank details (vi du: email PayPal). Method co requires_bank_details=false hien thi 1 o nhap payment_info.

confirmation_source.ref: qikfiliate/dashboard - payment and payout request (03-payment-and-payout-request.md) v1 Section: Payment Method & Payout Request Journey > Bước 1 — Chọn phương thức thanh toán (Account → Payment Info)

topic: requires_bank_details=true -> phai dien 7 field ngan hang thay vi 1 chuoi don gian
statement: Theo tai lieu `qikfiliate/Domain Entities` Section: User (Affiliate) (corroborate boi `dashboard - payment and payout request` Section: Buoc 1, va `admin - invoices and payment methods` Section: Payment Method), khi payment method da chon co requires_bank_details = true, affiliate phai dien 7 field ngan hang co cau truc (User.payment_details, cast array) thay vi 1 o payment_info don gian.

confirmation_source.ref: qikfiliate/dashboard - payment and payout request (03-payment-and-payout-request.md) v1 Section: Payment Method & Payout Request Journey > Bước 1 — Chọn phương thức thanh toán (Account → Payment Info)

topic: 7 field ngan hang gom ten ngan hang, chi nhanh, loai tai khoan (Savings/Checking)...
statement: Theo tai lieu `dashboard - payment and payout request` Section: Buoc 1, 7 o nhap cho method yeu cau bank details gom: ten ngan hang, ten chi nhanh, so chi nhanh, loai tai khoan (Savings/Checking), so tai khoan, ten chu tai khoan, ten chu tai khoan dang Katakana. Tai lieu tu neu chua xac nhan voi PO viec field Katakana co phai nhu cau thuc te dang dung hay chi chuan bi san - xem unknowns.

topic: Affiliate chi thay cac payment method visible=true VA dung country

confirmation_source.ref: qikfiliate/dashboard - payment and payout request (03-payment-and-payout-request.md) v1 Section: Payment Method & Payout Request Journey > Bước 1 — Chọn phương thức thanh toán (Account → Payment Info)

statement: Theo tai lieu `dashboard - payment and payout request` Section: Luu y rui ro - hardcode PayPal/Payoneer tren frontend, `admin - invoices and payment methods` Section: Journey - Them 1 phuong thuc thanh toan moi, va `known issues edge cases` Section: F1 (3 tai lieu doc lap dong thuan), component PayoutBlock.vue hien hardcode cung: payment_method_id === 1 duoc coi la PayPal (ap dieu kien hien thi 'can balance > $50 moi rut duoc'), id === 2 duoc coi la Payoneer (hien thi 'khong gioi han toi thieu') - hardcode theo ID, KHONG doc field nao tu PaymentMethod de suy ra dieu kien nay. Day la hanh vi SAI dang ton tai (known defect ve UI hien thi), KHONG phai expected result - giu OBSERVED_CURRENT, KHONG duoc nang len CONFIRMED_EXPECTED.

topic: KNOWN DEFECT: xoa/tao lai record PayPal/Payoneer doi ID -> dieu kien hien thi sai lech
statement: Theo tai lieu `dashboard - payment and payout request` Section: Luu y rui ro, va `known issues edge cases` Section: F1, neu admin xoa roi tao lai record PayPal (hoac Payoneer) trong bang payment_methods, ban ghi moi se nhan ID khac (vi du #15, vi auto-increment khong tai su dung ID cu) - khi do dong chu dieu kien hardcode tren UI KHONG CON KHOP voi ID thuc; dieu kien hien thi 'can balance > $50' tren UI cho affiliate se KHONG AP DUNG DUNG (frontend khong con nhan dien duoc #15 la PayPal). Day la he qua truc tiep cua known defect KB-007 - giu OBSERVED_CURRENT, KHONG duoc nang len CONFIRMED_EXPECTED.

topic: Dieu kien thuc o backend khong phu thuoc ID, van tinh dung
statement: Theo tai lieu `known issues edge cases` Section: F1, mac du UI co the hien dieu kien sai (xem KB-007/KB-008), dieu kien thuc o backend (InvoiceService::canCreateByUser) hoan toan KHONG phu thuoc ID cu the nao va van tinh dung.

confirmation_source.ref: qikfiliate/known issues edge cases (08-known-issues-edge-cases.md) v1 Section: Known Issues & Edge Cases > F. Liên quan tới affiliate dashboard (frontend) > F1. Frontend hardcode ID của PayPal (`1`) và Payoneer (`2`) để áp điều kiện rút tiền riêng

topic: KNOWN DEFECT: affiliate co the thay thong bao dieu kien rut tien sai lech tren UI
statement: Theo tai lieu `known issues edge cases` Section: F1, do loi hardcode ID (KB-007/KB-008), affiliate co the thay thong bao dieu kien rut tien SAI LECH tren UI (hien thi sai nguong can dat) du backend van chan/cho phep dung. Tai lieu tu neu muc do nghiem trong: gay nham lan trai nghiem nhung KHONG gay sai so tien thuc te. Claim nay hedged (tu danh dau chua chac chan ve pham vi anh huong) - giu OBSERVED_CURRENT, KHONG duoc nang len CONFIRMED_EXPECTED.
